definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese custom of enjoying the beauty of flowers, especially cherry blossoms, typically as a social gathering in parks.

{花見|はなみ} is composed of ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flower) + ⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧ (viewing).

CULTURAL NOTE:
Hanami primarily refers to cherry blossom (⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧) viewing in spring, a beloved tradition in Japan. People gather under cherry trees to eat, drink, and enjoy the blossoms.
